duplicate_row_check.name: Duplicate Row Check (X1)
duplicate_row_check.query: SELECT X1, COUNT(*) FROM credit_data GROUP BY X1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

null_check_x1.name: Null Check X1
null_check_x1.query: SELECT * FROM credit_data WHERE X1 IS NULL

null_check_x5.name: Null Check X5
null_check_x5.query: SELECT * FROM credit_data WHERE X5 IS NULL

outlier_check_x6.name: Outlier Check X6
outlier_check_x6.query: SELECT * FROM credit_data WHERE CAST(X6 AS REAL) < 0

outlier_check_x7.name: Outlier Check X7
outlier_check_x7.query: SELECT * FROM credit_data WHERE CAST(X7 AS REAL) < 0

target_check_y.name: Target Variable Check
target_check_y.query: SELECT * FROM credit_data WHERE "default payment next month" NOT IN (0,1)
